introDesc: OnSuite is an industrial software family consisting of 11 modules. Each module can be deployed independently or as an integrated suite, on-premise or in the cloud. It is designed with React + C# API + MS SQL architecture, stored procedure-focused approach and fully automated SQL testing with tSQLt. It offers open protocol support with OPC UA, PackML, ISA-88, MTConnect, REST and MQTT.
